findings.explanation: local.value_policies selects a policy when allow or deny is non-null, and the 'exactly one rule kind' validation counts allow = [] as set, so { allow = [] } passes validation and plans. The resulting rule's values block carries no allowed or denied values, which the Org Policy API rejects (or, if the provider drops the empty block, a rule with no kind) at apply time. Principle is a best fit: this is an apply-time correctness bug.
findings.remediation: Add a validation requiring at least one allow or deny value whenever allow or deny is set.
findings.title: var.policies accepts a list policy with empty allow/deny lists, producing a rule with no values
